worldcombat.skill.leafblade.summary: Wield a leaf like a sword and, from where you stand, sweep one close diagonal cut in the chosen direction: the edge sweeps from the left-front low side to the right-front high side and settles only the first foe it truly meets, stopping at a wall. It does not step toward the target, shave defence or splash nearby foes — you pick the position so the target falls into the edge; it has a heightened critical-hit chance. Two-handed form is heavier and slower; one-handed form is quicker and cleaner.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.use.0: Sweep one close diagonal leaf cut in the chosen direction
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.use.1: Cut only the first foe the edge meets, with no splash
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.use.2: Pick your own position so the target falls into the edge
Swing one close diagonal leaf cut in the chosen direction for about %1$s physical contact damage to the first foe the edge meets; the blade reaches %2$s blocks, so standing too far away misses.
The edge sweeps a %1$s-degree diagonal arc; each swing settles only the first foe it meets, with no extra splash and no extra defence reduction.
This move has a heightened critical-hit chance; pick your own position and let the target fall into the edge to cut it.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.twohand.on: Two-handed form: edge power ×1.2 and swing span ×1.1, but +3 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery and +6 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.twohand.off: One-handed form (default): faster wind-up and 4 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.95 and a slightly narrower span.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.growth.0: From level %1$s the edge power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.preference.t: On: edge power ×1.2 and swing span ×1.1, at +3 ticks wind-up, +2 recovery and +6 cooldown — for settling a fight in one blow. Off (one-handed form, default): faster wind-up and 4 ticks less cooldown, but power ×0.95 and a slightly narrower span — for repeated cuts up close.
worldcombat.skill.leafblade.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; leaf blade must be within its own blade reach, so this stays smaller than the ranged moves.
On: when a foe drops below four tenths of its health this quick cut is preferred, to finish it or force a window. Off: health is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary melee heavy hit.
